## Product Categories

### Security & Surveillance
Category: https://aslielectronics.com/categories/security-surveillance/

**Products:** IP cameras (indoor, outdoor, PTZ, 4K), AHD cameras, NVR and DVR recorders (4CH to 16CH), biometric attendance systems (face recognition + fingerprint), CCTV accessories (junction boxes, brackets, mounts), video doorbells, dash cameras, baby monitor cameras. Prices from 30 QAR to 2,500 QAR.

### Network & Communications
Category: https://aslielectronics.com/categories/network--communications/

**Products:** PoE switches (4-port to 24-port, 65W to 300W), gigabit switches, WiFi 6 access points, 4G LTE routers with SIM slot, WiFi range extenders, PABX and IP PBX systems (8 to 64 channel), IP telephones, network cabinets (2U to 42U), patch panels, cable managers, rack shelves, PDU power distribution. Prices from 30 QAR to 1,500 QAR.

### Smart Home
Category: https://aslielectronics.com/categories/smart-home/

**Products:** Smart switches (WiFi + Tuya-compatible, 1-gang to 4-gang), smart door locks (fingerprint, PIN, RFID, app), video doorphones (10-inch WiFi panel), IR controllers, smart plugs with USB-C. All Tuya app compatible. Prices from 25 QAR to 600 QAR.

### Audio
Category: https://aslielectronics.com/categories/audio/

**Products:** PA amplifiers (40W to 880W, 1-4 zones), ceiling speakers (6W to 25W), wall mount speakers (20W, 40W), hanging speakers (20W), Bluetooth ceiling speakers, volume controllers, microphones. For mosques, schools, offices, and commercial spaces. Prices from 20 QAR to 1,500 QAR.

### Cables
Category: https://aslielectronics.com/categories/cable/

**Products:** Cat6 network cable (305m drums, bare copper, CCA, copper clad), coaxial cable (RG59, RG6, RG59+2C), HDMI 2.0 cables (1.5M to 20M), HDMI splitters and extenders, USB RJ45 extenders, video baluns. Prices from 5 QAR to 500 QAR.
